name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: Theramore's people are watching Brackenwall and other dangers near their borders. You are sent west through Dustwallow Marsh to find Private Hendel.

sections.title: West Along the Road
sections.body: A guard detail waits west of you in Dustwallow Marsh, where Private Hendel watches over Theramore's infiltrators. They have been observing Brackenwall and searching for other threats near the borders. Look for the tents along the road to find Hendel.

faq.answer: Private Hendel is on guard duty, protecting Theramore's infiltrators while they rest.
They have been keeping tabs on Brackenwall, the Horde base, and looking for other threats to Theramore's borders.

faq.q: Where can I find Private Hendel?
faq.answer: Private Hendel is west of you, by the tents along the road in Dustwallow Marsh.
They are watching Brackenwall and looking for other dangers near Theramore's borders.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you are sent to find a Theramore guard watching the Horde base at Brackenwall and other threats to the borders.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Missing Diplomat
